content.title: Texas ice cream maker Blue Bell announces Tin Roof flavor returns
content.text: San Antonio Express-NewsHearst Newspapers LogoSkip to main contentNews//LocalBlue Bell's Tin Roof ice cream is returning to store shelves for limited timeBy John-Henry Perera, Food EditorJan 9, 2023A tub and bowl of Blue Bell's Tin Roof ice cream. The Brenham, Texas ice cream maker announced it was making a return on Jan. 5, 2023.Blue Bell/HandoutBlue Bell's Tin Roof flavor, which originally launched in 1980, is back — but only for a limited time.Keep WatchingWatch MoreThe Brenham ice cream maker announced the news a few days ago, promising its classic flavor would hit store refrigerator shelves soon.AdvertisementArticle continues below this adBAN ON ICE CREAM?: These are the weirdest Houston-area laws you might not know aboutThe 2023 version comes with some new carton art, but it still has the same flavors: vanilla ice cream with a chocolate sundae sauce and roasted peanuts in a dark chocolate flavored coating.Tin Roof had a rather infamous moment in 2019 when a San Antonio teenager was caught licking a tub of it at a Lufkin area Walmart.More For YouLeague City's newest superhero origin story: DoorDashA League City man's food delivery runs unintentionally birthed a superhero origin story....Louisiana fan-favorite boudin, cracklins store expands to KatyThe fan-favorite supermarket in Scott has captivated drivers with its boudin, cracklins...Jan 9, 2023John-Henry PereraFood EditorJohn-Henry Perera is the food editor for Chron. JP has been with Hearst for 10 years and is responsible for all the general eating coverage in Houston.
